name: diff-sharing
description: Generate Git or Difftastic code-diff sites for local preview or ngrok sharing.

interface.shortDescription: Preview code-diff reports locally or share a public URL.
interface.longDescription: Generates a browsable Difftastic-first structural diff site with a Git fallback and inline or side-by-side layouts. The skill uses local previews unless public sharing is requested.
defaultPrompt: Preview this branch's changes as a local diff report.
Generate a code-diff report and share its public URL.
